Since early March Pinkert st from Lawrence to central ave has been dug up and filled in with sand and loose rock.  I have not seen any work being down on repaving the road in weeks.  When ever there is rain, even a small amount.  The rain floods the road. Especially in front of 91 and 85 Pinkert.  To the point it is difficult to get in and out of the house.   I can’t walk down the side walk.  I have to jump the fence and go through a neighbor’s yard to avoid walking through 6-10 inch of water.  It’s becoming a safety issue and makes me concerned it’s flooding basements in the area.  Also, there are signs that ray, “no parking Monday-Friday 7-4. “. Which make it challenging, when no one is working or trying to fix the problem.

issues.description: The stone drain cover is a major obstruction as it comes out too far and it has too jagged of an edge. Given the tight / narrowness of this road and the location of the drain right at the blind curve it becomes even more of an obstruction. It sliced 2 of my tires resulting in 2 flat tires! I had to move over for a larger truck that was coming on the opposite side. I know this issue has been brought up to the town before and nothing has been done to fix it.

A work crew was at that location a week or so ago and since then the manhole cover is very loose. Whenever a car drives over it, it clanks very loudly and I even saw it moving today when I was walking by. Seems dangerous. This manhole is near the corner of Linnaean and Bowdoin, right in front of 22 Linnaean and the painted yellow road lines go right through it. There's another manhole close by, but this is the one that's loose.
